subject: Vendor onboarding: DPA, SOC 2 snapshot, subprocessor inventory and PO routing
messages:
From: Alex Park <procurement@halberd.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-02-18T09:15:00-08:00
Subject: Onboarding documents needed to issue PO

Hi Evelyn,

We're ready to issue a purchase order for Redwood Inference but procurement requires the following artifacts before we can route the PO internally: a signed DPA (or DocuSign envelope), a recent SOC 2 snapshot or report access link, and a current subprocessor inventory.

Can you send over the DPA (we can e-sign), a downloadable SOC 2 snapshot, and confirm whether cloud providers/analytics vendors are listed as subprocessors? Also please include the billing/contact info we should put on the PO (bill-to email and remit address).

Targeting vendor onboarding by end of next week — appreciate quick confirmation so our finance team can schedule PO creation.

Thanks,
Alex Park
Procurement Analyst
Halberd Systems

Attachments: none
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-02-18T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding documents needed to issue PO

Hi Alex — thanks for the note. Looping in Ben (billing & vendor ops) and Karthik (legal/procurement) to help close this out.

Quick summary / attachments included:
- Attached: Redwood_DPA_v1.2.pdf (we can accept DocuSign).
- Attached: SOC2_snapshot_2025-11-01.pdf — this is the redacted snapshot we share for procurement gating. If you need the full report we'll route through our security team.
- Attached: subprocessor_inventory.csv — includes cloud infra and managed services.
- Attached: PO_template_HALBERD.pdf — optional template for your convenience.

PO routing / billing details:
- Bill-to email: billing@redwood.inference.com
- Remit address: Redwood Inference, PO Box 4821, San Francisco, CA 94111
- AP contact: Ben Carter (ben.carter@redwood.inference.com) — please cc on the PO so we can pick up the ticket.

DocuSign link for the DPA is here: https://www.docusign.com/en/signer/abc123-dpa-redwood (we'll generate a DocuSign envelope if you prefer).

Let us know if your security team has specific questions about the subprocessor list or the SOC 2 snapshot — Karthik can speak to those details.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Manager, Customer Success Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_v1.2.pdf, SOC2_snapshot_2025-11-01.pdf, subprocessor_inventory.csv, PO_template_HALBERD.pdf
From: Alex Park <procurement@halberd.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-02-19T09:23:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding documents needed to issue PO

Thanks Evelyn — got the attachments. A couple quick clarifications from our security and finance folks:

1) The DPA: can your legal team accept a 48-hour turnaround for redline review? We often need to propose two small edits around data retention and subprocessor notification cadence.
2) Subprocessors: can you confirm whether AWS (us-west-2) and Google Cloud Platform (us-east1) are both listed and whether you have a designated contact for each? Our vendor risk team also asked for confirmation that encryption at-rest is enabled for customer data.
3) PO: our AP needs the exact tax ID and whether Redwood accepts ACH payments (preferred). If so, please provide remittance instructions or confirm that invoices should be emailed to billing@redwood.inference.com.

If it's easier, send a DocuSign envelope with the DPA and we will sign and return after a short review.

Appreciate the help — Alex

On Thu, Feb 19, 2026 at 9:23 AM Alex Park <procurement@halberd.com> wrote:
> (sent from Halberd procurement group)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alex Park <procurement@halberd.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-02-19T10:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Onboarding documents needed to issue PO

Alex — thanks for the questions. A few clarifications from legal/security: 

1) DPA redlines: we can accept a short review window. For standard PO-sized deals we typically agree to review redlines within 48–72 hours. If your proposed edits are limited to retention and notification timing, we can pre-authorize a standard counterproposal to speed execution. Please send any redlines to legal@redwood.inference.com.

2) Subprocessors: per the attached CSV, primary infrastructure subprocessors are Amazon Web Services (us-west-2) and Google Cloud Platform (us-east1). Managed analytics services listed: MetricQ Inc. (analytics) and StoreCache Ltd. (caching). We maintain a live inventory and notify customers per the DPA clause (30 days for non-critical additions; immediate notice for critical changes). For vendor contacts we can provide the points of contact to your vendor risk team — please confirm if they want vendor-level emails or just the infrastructure locations.

3) Encryption and controls: we use AES-256 encryption at rest for customer KV stores and object storage; keys are managed in our KMS with role-based access. We can produce a short controls statement for your risk team; if they need something more formal (e.g., encryption certificate or syslog traces), we can schedule a security call.

4) Billing / payments: we accept ACH and wire. Ben, can you post the ACH remittance instructions into the Drive folder and confirm the tax ID?

Happy to hop on a quick call with your risk or AP teams if that helps expedite the PO.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy
Redwood Inference

- If your security team wants an additional controls brief (encryption certificate), Karthik can coordinate a short call.

Thanks all — looking forward to onboarding Halberd.
